text_block_list.text:
Just one step short...
That was so close...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: No... I could never handle a crane game like that...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It had the same kind of thrills and excitement as a race,
so as a spectator... I found it quite fascinating.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
You can always decorate your room with something else...
So please, don't let it get you down too much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
